collection.title: Mercedes-Benz S Class Saloon 1991 to 1998 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz S Class Saloon 1991 to 1998 (W140) will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side on the passengers side. This model uses the Heavy Duty Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
